notes.title: [Dev Log - 4] This Week's Updates & Future Plans!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614856/a8d224273b902a5a6f0585664001c82433045d73.png"][/img][/p]
[h3]【Update Contents】[/h3]
[p][b]New Mode Added: Last Stand Defense[/b][/p]
[p]Unlocked after clearing 4-10. Click on the Ferris wheel to enter this mode.[/p]
[p]✧ This mode lasts for 35 days, with the final 5 days as challenge stages.
✧ Players will begin on Day 1 in the Preparation Phase.[/p]
[p]✧ During the Preparation Phase, players can access the following functions:
✧ Basic Prep Functions: Change (Units/Equipment), adjust sortie characters.
✧ Frontline Base Functions: Consume resources to upgrade. These values only apply to the current run and will reset after the operation ends.
✧ Construction and upgrades are limited by the base level.[/p]
[p]✧ When entering combat, all resources will be capped based on base bonuses.
✧ After the final wave appears on a given day, resource generation will stop.
✧ After defeating all zombies, the day’s battle ends, and results are calculated immediately.[/p]
[p]✧ Upon results calculation, all buildings are reclaimed, and part of the construction cost is refunded.
✧ The left-side rewards will be granted immediately.[/p]
[p]✧ After results calculation, the player will return to Preparation Phase, and the game will auto-save.
✧ Re-entering this mode will resume from the saved state.
✧ Upgrading the base will be saved (resources and level), but buildings and upgrades will not affect the save.[/p]
[p]✧ If the base is destroyed, the operation ends.
✧ When the operation ends, base level and days passed will be reset.
✧ For more information, visit the Frontline Base in the stage.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]New Character Added[/b][/p]
[p]A top student from Zone4 with bow-enhancing abilities.[/p]
[p]Main Skills:
Precision Shot: Bow damage + (200/210/220/230/240/250)%
Aimed Focus: Attack interval +100%
Mutant Slayer: Bonus bow damage to mutants + (15/17/19/21/23/25)%
Bow Mastery: Bow build time -15 seconds[/p]
[p]Sub Skills:
Precision Shot: Bow damage + (150/160/170/180/190/200)%
Aimed Focus: Attack interval +100%
Mutant Slayer: Bonus bow damage to mutants + (2.5/3.0/3.5/4.0/4.5/5.0)%[/p]
[p]Unlock Method: Last Stand Defense[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]6 New Buildings Added[/b][/p]
[p]Unlock Method: Last Stand Defense[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]New Item: High Purity Serum[/b][/p]
[p]Function: Enhance the serum buff in units.
Currently auto-applied at Lv1, maximum Lv5.[/p]
[p]Unlock Method: Last Stand Defense[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]UI Improvements[/b][/p]
[p]Stats displayed on buildings/units in-game now include current buffs, but not extra damage against specific zombie types.[/p]
[p][/p]
[h3]【Updates Since Last Dev Log】[/h3]
[p]*Skip if already read, continue to Future Plans[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]New Challenge Mode Added[/b][/p]
[p]Challenge Mode added for Zone1, Zone2, and Zone3.
If the difficulty feels too high, clear 4-8 first to gain bonus effects.
Clearing on Normal or above grants rewards.
The difficulty selector frame will turn green upon completion.
Zone4 currently has no Challenge Mode.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]New Alert Animation[/b][/p]
[p]When an alert is triggered, the alert animation will play.
When not triggered, no animation will be shown. (Certain story scenes may disable alerts.)[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]New Feature: Dual Survivor Sortie[/b][/p]
[p]Survivor interface updated[/p]
[p]The bottom right button has been removed; click the survivor icon instead.
Unlocks after clearing Stage 3-1.[/p]
[p]The first survivor activates main skills only.
The second survivor activates sub skills only.[/p]
[p]0–5 yellow stars: Triggers leadership skills (Lv1–6).
5 yellow stars: Triggers support skill (Lv1).
1–5 red stars: Triggers support skill (Lv2–6).[/p]
[p][/p]
[h3]【Future Plans】[/h3]
[p][b]Zone5[/b][/p]
[p]Players can now acquire resources more quickly.
Stage pacing will also be faster than before.[/p]
[p]Story[/p]
[p]Stronger buildings and units.
A more powerful and expensive weapon will be added for each weapon type.[/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]Zone4 Challenge Mode[/b][/p]
[p][/p]
[p][b]Cloud Save[/b][/p]
[p]Due to most players having playtime over 10 hours, switching PCs will currently cause save files to be lost (as they're stored locally).
We are testing cloud save locally on our own machines.
Since misconfiguration of cloud save could cause loss of data, extensive testing is required. This will not be implemented in the short term.[/p]

notes.title: Important Update
notes.content:
[b][Important] Game Title Change[/b]
Someone: "You just added all the tags to the game title. Can you come up with a better name?"
...
... (Discussion ongoing) ...
...
Developer: "Alright..."

[b]【Important】Pixel Art Characters Added[/b]
All characters have been remade into pixel art, and the new art style will be the default when starting the game.
Players who already own the game can freely switch to the original character style via the top-right corner.
The original art style will continue to be supported, so there's no need to worry about it being removed in the future.

[b]【Important】New Guide for Levels 1-10[/b]
If you find the game difficult, entering any level will show some important survival tips (you don’t need to complete the level, just watch the dialogue).

[b]【Important】Complete Story for Zone 3 Added[/b]
This chapter includes important survival tips, especially useful for players wanting to challenge [Hard Mode].
If you find it difficult, please don’t skip [Skip].
After completing Zone 3, you will unlock the character exchange feature (5 Serum = 1 character exchange).

[b]New Character: The 11th Female Survivor[/b]
Character exchange is 5 Serum: 1 time.

[b]The 11th Female Survivor Unlocked[/b]
A girl from Zone 4 with unstable mental health and filled with madness.
She is a powerful close-range fighter.
Unlock Condition: Complete Zone 3 and unlock the character exchange feature.

[b]Character Profiles Added for All Characters[/b]

[b]Difficulty System Adjustments[/b]
The game is set to "Easy Mode" by default to prevent players from mistakenly starting on a higher difficulty.

Easy Mode: All zombies’ HP -50%, serum drop rate significantly reduced.

Normal Mode: All zombies’ HP -25%, serum drop rate slightly reduced.

Hard Mode: No changes.

[b]Combat Adjustments[/b]

Removed the setting where the sniper rifle would prioritize attacking distant enemies. Now, it won't switch targets before hitting the target in range, allowing it to attack mutants.

However, zombies behind the mutants are up to you to deal with...

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where troop attack angles were abnormal after optimization.

Fixed a bug where some units occasionally locked onto the wrong target.

Fixed an issue with Polish language showing content from other language packs.

[b]Development Plan Preview[/b]

Next, we will prioritize creating Zone 4 content.

Based on player feedback, the following items may be further improved:

More tutorials for new players.

Attack range display added in Easy Mode (because the zombie spawn lag issue has been resolved).

[b]Difficulty Issue Survey[/b]
If you feel the game difficulty is unusually high, for example, if you can't even get through Easy Mode, please leave a comment.
Currently, I developed the game with "Hard Mode++", and after I completed it myself, I lowered the difficulty to what is now "Hard Mode" for release.
So... I really don’t know if it’ll make players feel like "this game is impossible to complete".

Thank you to all players for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Partial Setting Disclosure and Adjustments
notes.content:
(This article translation exists and is AI-generated; it will be revised in future dev logs)

[Zombie Lag, Player Feedback, Attack Modes] Updates and Adjustments
Currently, the game becomes very laggy when there are too many zombies.
Actually, we’ve been making updates all along to improve performance during high zombie counts.
On the development side, player units scan the map for enemies every frame.
Because of this, that part of the system has undergone many revisions, which later caused some bugs.
This update addresses (1) player feedback, (2) lag issues, and (3) game difficulty.
Three areas of adjustment.
If I don’t say anything, players may feel confused or even upset.
But if I explain everything, the fun of the game might be reduced.
Balancing all that, I’ve decided to reveal some of the settings.
There are several types of unit attack modes:
Attack the nearest target and don’t switch until it’s dead.
Attack the nearest target.
Attack the farthest target and don’t switch until it’s dead.
Attack the farthest target.
Others are no longer applied: for example, attack the nearest base.

Which unit uses which mode — I hope players can figure it out by themselves to preserve a bit of fun.
Since this is my first time making a tower defense game, I always feel that fully revealing all the settings would reduce the fun.
It’s like giving a puzzle to a friend — if I just give the answer, it’s not interesting anymore.
So I want to give a few hints, but not too many.
But not everyone likes guessing games.
I don’t know how much I should say — for those who want to know or don’t want to know, I hope you can understand >_<
Hope you all have a pleasant experience.

[Main Page Can Select 3 Backgrounds]
[Main Page Can Hide Character]

Prepare time, sell, and downgrade will 100% refund resources

Stage prize reset, old logic removed, new stage rewards will be shown in the stage detail panel.

notes.title: 【Dev Log】This Week’s Update & Future Plans!
notes.content:
Time flies, and another week has gone by. How much progress have we made on the things mentioned in last week’s dev log?
If you already know, you can skip the [Update List], since I also posted some updates during the week.
Due to time constraints, I used Google Translate and didn't support many languages.
Also, this dev log includes some [Future Plans], so if you're interested, check out the details below.
(Since we support multiple languages, some wording might sound weird—thanks for your understanding.)

[Update List]
[b]Zone 3[/b]
Happy to report that Zone 3 stages are now complete, offering more challenges for players.
Although… the story is still being translated...

[b]Character Skill Buffs[/b]
This time we did a major rebalance and buff for all characters, along with related testing.
Each of them now has their own playstyle, and you can build unique strategies in the tower defense game with them!

[b]Zombie Encyclopedia[/b]
You can open the encyclopedia during preparation.
It contains zombie information—
And your kill count too!!
After killing just one, you'll unlock the zombie's entry. (Just seeing them isn't enough...)
The more you kill, the more complete your analysis becomes, and you'll get more data about them.

[b]Achievement Badges[/b]
After adding difficulty levels, we also added corresponding achievement badges.

[b]Brand-New Map Backgrounds[/b]
Stages no longer use placeholder backgrounds.
We also adjusted the stage locations and achievement badge displays on the map!

[b]Weapon Icon Redesign[/b]
Because in the past... I had no inspiration at the time...

[b]Map Icon Redesign[/b]
Because in the past... I had no inspiration at the time...

[b]Zombie I Redesign[/b]
Because the original Zombie I was my first attempt at drawing…
After drawing a few more times, I felt it didn’t look good, so I replaced it.

[b]Sortie Count / Affection Display[/b]
That little heart in the lower left—each sortie adds +1.

[b]Brand-New UI[/b]
Because in the past... I had no inspiration at the time...

[b]UI Improvement - 1[/b]
Now the unit info UI only appears when you click on a squad.
If you don't click anything, the UI closes automatically.
Pressing [F] locks the UI so it won’t auto-open anymore (press again to toggle back to auto-open).

[b]UI Improvement - 2[/b]
When you successfully click, the selected tile turns red.

[b]Hotkey Support[/b]
Time control hotkeys: Space / Z / X / C
Quick sell items: Shift + E

[b]Text Speed Options[/b]
New text speed options added in the settings menu: 1x, 2x, 3x
(Actually, it's 1x, 3x, 5x — after testing with multiple languages, even 3x still feels slow!)

[Future Plans]
[b]New Stages[/b]
Not sure how many players have already cleared Zone 3 in a day,
but stages 31–40 are in the works!

[b]Limit Mode[/b]
Limit Mode is confirmed, but I want to make it more challenging.
So it will likely be added after dual-character deployment is available.

[b]Zone 3 & Future Story Content[/b]
Zone 3’s story is still being translated.
Because my code (character appearance logic) supports 11 languages at once, we need to complete translations before updating.
Fun fact:
I found that in the old language pack, I mistakenly translated "serum" (via copy-paste) as "sortie".
Also, I entered "button" as "massage"...

[b]2-Character Deployment[/b]
Still balancing—some combinations are way too strong, making other combos hard to balance!
Currently, it's planned for Zone 4, since Zone 2 with dual deployment is just too much... (Zombies and mutants would cry)
(Still considering for Zone 3...)

[b]More Characters[/b]
You’ve probably noticed 5 unreleased characters, but actually 3 more will appear in the upcoming story.
So I plan to pull back the current 5 characters.
Also, I have a big dilemma—
If I put all 5 into the beginner character pool, new players will have a harder time progressing.
So new characters might go into the Limit Mode pool and lean toward debuffs instead of only buffs.
After all, each of our current characters has a specialty—they’re masters of their own fields!
If the playstyle is too similar, it just feels off.

[b]Stage Rewards – Fixing Bad Luck!?[/b]
Reworked the first-clear rewards.
(Final amounts might differ.)
Zone 1 level 5–10: 3 serums
Zone 2 level 1–5: 5 serums
Zone 2 level 6+: 10 serums each time

[b]Lag From Too Many Monsters[/b]
Currently optimizing.

[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
Will be done, but there are too many elements not yet designed.
For now, I’m just logging everything that will be used for achievements,
so that once launched, we can auto-retrieve completed ones.

[Bug Fixes]
I sincerely apologize for some bugs,
and thank you all for reporting them—it really helps make the game better!
Fun fact:
I discovered that completing stage 1 would incorrectly trigger the first-clear reward for stage 8,
causing the text to display weirdly.

Lastly, thank you for reading all the way to the end.

notes.title: New Update (10 new levels, character ability adjustments, appearance updates)
notes.content:
New Features:

Added a button to disable dialogue during battle.
Added new levels Zone3 1-10.
Added new zombies.
Added new weapons.
The new levels are currently quite difficult; players wanting a challenge can attempt them after completing Zone2.

Redesigned Tier 1 Male Zombie (pixel art + icon).

Achievement badges display:
Completing a level without using resource boosts grants 3 badges.
Completing a level with 2x resource boost grants 2 badges.
Completing a level with 3x resource boost grants 1 badge.

When clicking a tile, the tile will show as red.
Upgrades and repairs are now less error-prone.
Zombies will block you from clicking tiles.

Added a button and shortcut key (F) to toggle equipment info during battle.

Repair costs halved.
Health bar no longer shown at 100% health.
No longer trigger repairs at 100% health.

Reduced serum rewards from completing levels.

When starting with 2x resources, killing mutants drops serum at 60%.
When starting with 3x resources, killing mutants drops serum at 30%.
Mutant Type II now drops 3 serums; drop rate affected by starting resources.

Pistol build cooldown changed to 20 seconds.
Defensive structure build cooldown changed to 30 seconds.

Major Character Ability Adjustments:
[Leader’s Presence] All units’ power increases by (15/17/19/21/23/25)%.
[Luck is also a part of strength!] Serum drops doubled.
[Quick Repair] Repair cooldown reduced by (40/45/50/60/65/70)%.
[Target the Fortress!] All defensive structures’ health increased by (400/600/800/1000/1200/1600).
[Upgrade Rebuild Tech] Defensive structures restore full health when upgraded.
[Defense Mastery] Defensive structure build cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.
[Bring Some Iron!] All production buildings’ iron output +10.
[Melee Power Mastery] When units are within 2.5 range, power increases by (15/17/19/21/23/25)%.
[Melee Genius] When units are within 2.5 range, health increases by (200/250/300/400/500/600); health doubles each upgrade (cannot be repaired).
[Upgrade Recovery] When units within 2.5 range upgrade, restore all health.
[Optimized Upgrade] All upgrade costs in battle reduced by (10/12/14/16/18/20)%.
[Battle Command] All defensive structure costs during battle reduced by (25/30/40/50/60/75)%.
[Bang Bang♡~] All penetration increased by (1/1/1/2/2/3).
[Sniper Reload Mastery] Sniper reload speed reduced by (70/75/80/85/90/95)%.
[Sniper Mastery] Sniper build cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.
[Cost Reduction - Shotgun] Base shotgun costs reduced by (25/30/40/50/60/75)%.
[Shotgun Reload Mastery] Shotgun reload speed reduced by (40/45/50/55/60/70)%.
[Spray] Shotgun firing interval reduced by (25/30/35/40/45/50)%.
[Shotgun Mastery] Shotgun build cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.
[Quick Preparation] All pistol costs during battle reduced by (25/30/40/50/60/75)%.
[Headshot] Pistol power increased by (50/75/100/150/200/250)%.
[Pistol Mastery] Pistol build cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.
[Agile Retreat] All items sold recover all resources fully.
[Rifle Power Mastery] Rifle power increased by (25/30/35/40/45/50)%.
[Armory] Base rifle costs during battle reduced by 150.
[Perfect Preparation] Rifle build cooldown reduced by 30 seconds.
[Production Specialization] All production buildings’ base productivity increased by (15/17/19/21/23/25)%, no effect if productivity is zero.

notes.title: 【Dev Log】Sharing the Journey: Upcoming Updates and Future Plans!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm the developer of this game.
This is the very first dev log—thank you to those who’ve left feedback before. I’ve truly read through it all and learned a lot from it.

The purpose of this post is twofold: to keep you updated on the game’s progress, and to start learning how to communicate my development thoughts with you all in a more natural way.
This is a brand new experience for me, and I’m still figuring out a comfortable rhythm. If you have any suggestions, feel free to let me know!

[h3]🛠️ [Upcoming Updates] What’s Coming Next[/h3]
Based on your feedback, I’m planning to add some of the features you mentioned. Here’s a quick preview!

[h3]📖 More Story Content[/h3]
Yes! I’m working on expanding the game’s story background and introducing a proper story opening.

The early version focused heavily on gameplay, so the story mainly served as a basic tutorial.
Now that I’ve put together a more complete world setting, I’ll be integrating it gradually and naturally—without interrupting the flow of gameplay.

[h3]🧩 New Levels & Story Expansion[/h3]
New levels will include fresh story elements, new defense towers, and more zombie types.
The full plan is to reach 30 stages, but since balancing and testing are key, I’ll be releasing them in batches of 10 stages at a time.

Alongside the levels, I’ll also be sharing some behind-the-scenes content.

To be honest, when I first started making this game, I was on what I’d call “full-speed dev mode”—
Basically developing like crazy while learning everything on the fly, without really knowing what a game developer should be doing.

Looking back now, I realize there’s a lot worth sharing from that experience.
I believe many solo developers who started from scratch may have gone through the same thing.

This dev log is a result of that reflection and growth—learning from others, and documenting the journey as I go.

[h3]🎮 New Game Modes in the Works[/h3]
[b]🔒 Challenge Mode (Tutorial + Limitations)[/b]
In response to your feedback about the lack of tutorials and the desire for more narrative, I’m planning to add a “Challenge Mode.”

This mode will feature specific gameplay restrictions, tutorial guidance, and some tricky conditions—
Designed to satisfy both:

New players who need clearer instructions

Veteran players who enjoy a good challenge

[b]📘 Story Mode (Updated from Classic Mode)[/b]
The original normal mode will be renamed “Story Mode.”
It will continue to include basic tutorials in the early stages, but also incorporate more storytelling elements as you progress.

This mode is designed to be accessible to everyone, with a focus on a smooth, enjoyable experience.
If I receive feedback that even the lowest difficulty is too tough, I’ll make adjustments accordingly.

[b]⌨️ Hotkey Support[/b]
I’ve also heard your requests for smoother controls. Here are the hotkeys coming soon:

Time Control:

Space: Pause / Resume
Z: 1x Speed
X: 2x Speed
C: 3x Speed

Quick Sell:
Shift + E: Instantly sell items

These additions should help make the game feel snappier and more responsive.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
This is first dev log!
In the next one, I’ll start including a proper “update list” and share in-development screenshots or gameplay visuals.
If you enjoy this kind of content, or want to see something specific, leave a comment or give it a like to let me know!

Thanks to every single one of you who took the time to read this—
Even if you’re just quietly following along, it means the world to me.

See you next time!
— Aozora, Developer

notes.title: Update Content / Preview:
notes.content:
[b]Update Applied[/b]
A new option has been added to all stages: "2x Resources" and "3x Resources".
When activated, you will receive multiplied resources at the start of the stage.
However, players who challenge themselves by not using these boosts will receive more [character draw items] as rewards upon stage completion, based on the difficulty.

[b]Upcoming Update[/b]
Issue: The story and tutorials are too short.
To be honest, just like the demo, I originally didn't plan to include a story in the game.
But since I'm already halfway through development, I figured—why not add some story elements?
And so, it really became just a little.
If I want to expand the content further, the translations will become a serious challenge.

[b]Why This Update[/b]
I've received feedback that the game is too difficult, and I sincerely apologize.
This is my first time making a tower defense game.
I understand that just because I can beat the game doesn't mean it's OK.
So during internal testing, even after I managed to clear the stages, I lowered the difficulty further.
However, after getting actual player feedback, I realized that still wasn’t enough.
Now I understand why many games offer multiple difficulty levels.
But this introduces a new problem:
When you say “Easy,” how easy is that? When you say “Normal,” what does that even mean?
Everyone has different standards.
So how can I balance the difficulty to meet everyone’s expectations?
etc...
This is the reason behind the new system, and hope this update can fix the difficult.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[b]Zone 2 difficulty reduced[/b]

Consider that gamers have different levels of acceptance of game difficulty.
The difficulty I initially set was that I could pass it myself.
We also received feedback during the demo, such as it was too easy and therefore boring.
Therefore, I set a difficulty level in Zone 2 that I also find difficult, and I am very sorry.
The difficulty of the general mode has been significantly reduced, and the number of zombies has been reduced by 15-30%.
Players who want a higher difficulty level will need to wait for the high difficulty mode to be opened.
I hope you can complete the normal mode with your favorite combination.

Due to the current number of translations, it is difficult to change teaching.
Therefore, if you want to make full use of each building and skill, it can only be discovered by the players themselves in exist version.
Due to feedback from some players, i am currently planning to combine [Story Mode] and [Restricted Mode (including the use of specific buildings)] into one.
In the later levels, you will be able to understand the characteristics and techniques of each building.

Since this is my first time making a tower defense game, the difficulty is actually a challenge for me.
I also know that just because I can pass the game doesn't mean there will be no problem, but I have no practical experience, so when it comes to the difficulty of the design, I can only say sorry and show sincerity to make changes when everyone is dissatisfied.

[b]Rewards increased[/b]
After Zone1 lv 10, you can get serum x1 for each successful defense.

[b]General bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]After the player clicks on a building, if the building is destroyed, the player can sell the building.
[*]After using a character to clear a game, the character's information is not unlocked normally
[/list]

notes.title: "Endzone Girls" is now live! Take on the challenge and protect your base!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

After a long period of development and testing, I'm excited to announce that my game "Apocalypse Zombie TD" is now officially available on Steam! This is a tower defense game that I developed on my own, combining strategy, resource management, and survival elements. I hope to provide you with an exciting, challenging gameplay experience!

Game Features:

End-of-the-World Survival and Tower Defense Fusion: In a harsh post-apocalyptic world, build defenses and fend off waves of zombies.

Rich Strategic Choices: Various towers and skills allow you to adapt your strategy to different situations and challenges.

Character Gacha System: After completing levels and defeating zombies, you can unlock new characters. Each character comes with unique skills and a small backstory, adding diversity and depth to the game.

Intense Combat and Progression: As the game progresses, enemies grow stronger, and upgrading defense towers and managing resources become key to success.

I’d like to thank all the players who have supported the game! I will continue working hard to improve the game and deliver more updates and challenges. I hope you enjoy playing it!
